name: BACH_0164_FSIM_stain3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, second-model agreement and typical image quality all support this [F1].

## Confidence
|Signal|Value|Reading|
|---|---|---|
|Top probabilities|Benign 100%|Near-certain Benign|
|Conformal set|Benign only|Single class|
|Reliability / OOD|0.997 / 76th percentile|Input looks typical|
|Second-model (MUSK) agreement|Yes|Same top class|
|Similar cases|4 of 5 Benign [F5]|Mostly consistent; one Normal|

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Scores below typical; lowers invasive association [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 0, 5, 9) · ↓ invasive · High score; associated with lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scarce here; slightly raises concept-model invasive score [F4] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Scores low; small lowering effect · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier. Leans on Unreliable: normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated stain degradation (severity 3) may shift results; reliability error AUROC is only 0.69.
- Probability near 100% reflects dataset-level calibration only; ECE 0.05 (CI 0.03–0.18), 132 images.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 5, 9** — Confirm gland architecture is benign, not neoplastic.
2. **Region 11** — Look for infiltrating stroma or pleomorphism; both concepts peak here.
3. **Region 7** — Check sparse fibrous stroma/fat and duct-confined atypia (weak concept).
